name: HBM Nigeria Plc (formerly Lafarge Africa)
source: Rebuilt 2026-11-21 from the audited consolidated statement of profit or loss in Lafarge Africa Plc (now HBM Nigeria Plc) annual report for the year ended 31 December 2025, group column, N'000 scaled to naira: revenue 1,066,304,773 and 696,757,959; cost of sales 448,936,725 and 350,047,400; gross profit 617,368,048 and 346,710,559; operating profit 392,099,733 and 193,005,216; net finance 19,216,895 income and 40,486,262 cost; profit before tax 411,316,628 and 152,264,885; income tax 138,196,316 and 52,119,604; profit 273,120,312 and 100,145,281. Operating expenses are selling and distribution plus administrative plus impairment less other income, which ties to the printed operating profit in both years. The FY2025 and FY2024 columns previously held rounded estimates (revenue 1,070,000,000,000 and 696,800,000,000) that did not tie to the printed gross profit. FY2024 carries a minimum tax of 254,069 which sits between net finance and profit before tax. Earlier years are unchanged.
